applicable_when: The kernel is a GEMM (M=7840, N=40, K=240) with hardcoded BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32 and 128 threads. Only 123 blocks are launched for 132 SMs (< 1 wave), giving 0.23 waves/SM and 6.25% achieved occupancy. The dominant stall (64.7% of cycles) is MIO/shared-memory scoreboard, caused by 11.9-way shared memory bank conflicts on the B-matrix load. The B matrix is loaded with stride pattern idx_n + 40*idx_m then broadcast with 240*idx_n, which creates non-contiguous, non-coalesced access patterns through shared memory. On Hopper (H200), TMA descriptors offload address generation to dedicated hardware, enable asynchronous bulk copies via tl.make_block_ptr / tl.load with block pointers, and naturally produce coalesced 2D tile loads that eliminate the manual index arithmetic causing bank conflicts. Adding @triton.autotune explores smaller BLOCK_N values (N=40 means BLOCK_N=64 wastes ~37% of N-tiles) and different num_stages to pipeline memory latency.
